data.body:
[P2] Check recorded cancellation before emitting a terminal End event

If the runtime caller is interrupted during result serialization and the serializer subsequently returns a small payload, cancellation is recorded before End runs. This guard remains false because `markInvocationReported()` runs only after the owner exits, while the earlier lifecycle check ran before serialization. Plugins therefore receive `SUCCEEDED` with no error even though the caller receives a retryable lifecycle failure; the OTel plugin also emits a terminal successful Workflow span. Recheck the recorded lifecycle failure before emitting terminal End, preserving acknowledged-result and fatal precedence. Add coverage where serialization returns normally after cancellation.
